title: Mauritian Chicken Biryani
steps: Wash rice (FOODON:00004320), soak 20 min, and parboil with star anise, cinnamon, and cloves until 70% cooked; drain.
Marinate chicken (FOODON:02020149) with garlic, ginger, yogurt or vinegar, cumin, turmeric, curry powder, and salt. Rest 1 hour.
Fry sliced onions (FOODON:03301704) in oil (FOODON:03305263) until deep golden; reserve half.
Sauté tomatoes (FOODON:03301453) and tomato paste (FOODON:03301455) with the aromatics; add chicken and cook until sealed and lightly saucy.
Layer half the rice in a heavy pot, spoon chicken masala, scatter potatoes if using, then top with remaining rice.
Dot with fried onions, herbs (mint/parsley), a squeeze of lime, and saffron essence if using.
Seal the pot (dum) and steam on low until rice is fluffy and chicken is tender.
Fluff gently and serve hot.

title: Rougaille Saucisse
steps: Prick and simmer sausages (FOODON:00002958) 5–10 min to remove excess salt; drain and slice.
Sauté sliced onion (FOODON:03301704) in a little oil until soft; add garlic paste (FOODON:03305217) and cook 30 sec.
Add chopped tomatoes (FOODON:03301453); cook down to a chunky sauce.
Stir in sausage slices and simmer 5–8 min so the sauce coats and reduces.
Adjust seasoning and serve with rice or farata.

title: Fish Vindaye
steps: Cut fish fillet (FOODON:00002742) into pieces, season lightly and shallow-fry until just golden; set aside.
In the same pan, add a little oil; bloom cumin (FOODON:00003396) briefly.
Add sliced tomatoes (FOODON:03301453) and cook to a soft base.
Pour in vinegar (FOODON:03301705) with a splash of water to make a bright, pickly sauce.
Return fish to the pan, coat gently and simmer 2–3 min. Cool—vindaye tastes better after it rests.

title: Octopus Vindaye
steps: Simmer octopus (FOODON:03310498) in lightly salted water until tender; slice.
Sauté onion (FOODON:03301704) in a little oil, then stir in curry powder (FOODON:03301842) to bloom.
Add vinegar (FOODON:03301705) and a little cooking liquor to form a punchy sauce.
Fold in octopus slices and coat. Simmer 2–3 min; rest before serving so flavors develop.

title: Chicken Curry
steps: Brown sliced onion (FOODON:03301704) in oil until translucent.
Add curry powder (FOODON:03301842) and cook 30–45 sec to release aroma.
Stir in chopped tomatoes (FOODON:03301453) and cook to a thick base.
Add chicken pieces (FOODON:02020149); seal well, then add water to make a loose gravy.
Simmer until chicken is tender and sauce clings. Adjust seasoning and serve.

title: Beef Curry
steps: Sear beef cubes (FOODON:00001282) over medium-high heat; set aside.
In the same pot, soften onion (FOODON:03301704). Bloom curry powder (FOODON:03301842).
Add tomatoes (FOODON:03301453), then return beef and cover with water.
Simmer gently until beef is tender and gravy thickens (45–60 min).

title: Pork Curry
steps: Sear pork pieces (FOODON:00002570) to light gold; set aside.
Soften onion; bloom curry powder; add tomatoes to make a base.
Return pork, add water, and simmer until tender and saucy (35–45 min).

title: Fish Curry
steps: Sweat onion, then bloom curry powder briefly.
Add tomatoes and cook to a bright, thick sauce.
Lay fish pieces (FOODON:00002742) into the sauce; simmer gently 5–7 min until just cooked.

title: Shrimp Rougaille
steps: Sauté onion in a little oil; add garlic paste (FOODON:03305217).
Add chopped tomatoes and cook to a quick rougaille sauce.
Toss in cleaned prawns (FOODON:03307015) and cook 2–3 min until pink and just done.

title: Smoked Marlin Salad
steps: Flake smoked marlin (FOODON:03304348).
Combine with torn lettuce (FOODON:00003423) and thinly sliced onion.
Dress with lemon juice (FOODON:00003320) and a drizzle of oil; toss lightly and serve.

title: Sautéed Brèdes Mouroum
steps: Wash and roughly chop brèdes mouroum (FOODON:00005327).
Sauté sliced onion in oil (FOODON:03305263).
Add leaves, toss until just wilted and tender; season to taste.

title: Mine Frite (Mauritian Fried Noodles)
steps: Boil noodles (FOODON:03401095) until just tender; drain and oil lightly.
Stir-fry onion, then add prawns (FOODON:03307015) and cook until pink.
Toss in noodles; season with soy sauce (FOODON:03301115). Stir-fry until glossy and hot.

title: Bol Renversé
steps: Boil noodles (FOODON:03401095) until al dente; drain.
Stir-fry onion and chicken strips (FOODON:02020149) until almost cooked.
Add chopped tomato and a splash of water to make a light gravy.
Pack a serving bowl with the saucy chicken, then noodles on top; invert onto a plate to unmold (‘renversé’).

title: Bouillon Brèdes
steps: Bring water to a simmer; add sliced onion and spinach/brèdes (FOODON:00003495).
Season with salt (FOODON:03544059) and simmer just until leaves are tender and the broth tastes green and clean.

title: Farata (Mauritian Paratha)
steps: Mix flour (FOODON:03302798), salt (FOODON:03544059), oil (FOODON:03305263) and water (FOODON:00004429) to a soft dough; rest 20–30 min.
Divide, roll, oil-laminate (optional), then roll out again.
Cook on a hot tawa with a brush of oil until brown blisters form.

title: Dal Puri (Yellow Split Pea Flatbread)
steps: Boil and drain yellow split peas (FOODON:00005336); season with salt and ground black pepper. Dry out slightly and mash.
Make a soft dough with flour and water; rest.
Stuff dough balls with the pea filling, roll gently, and cook on a hot tawa until puffed and golden.

title: Dholl Curry
steps: Simmer split peas (FOODON:00005336) until tender; lightly mash.
In a pan, sauté onion and garlic paste; bloom curry powder.
Add the cooked peas and enough water for a ladleable curry; simmer 10 min and adjust seasoning.

title: Cari Banane (Green Banana Curry)
steps: Peel green bananas and cut into chunks; keep in salted water.
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add tomatoes and cook to a sauce.
Add bananas with a splash of water; simmer until just tender and the gravy clings.

title: Cari Bringelle (Eggplant Curry)
steps: Cube eggplant (FOODON:00003618) and salt briefly; pat dry.
Sauté onion, then bloom curry powder.
Add tomatoes; when saucy, add eggplant and simmer until soft and flavorful.

title: Cari Chouchou (Chayote Curry)
steps: Peel and dice chayote (FOODON:00003408).
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add chayote and a little water.
Simmer until tender-crisp and coated in gravy.

title: Cari Lalo (Taro Leaves Curry)
steps: Shred taro/spinach leaves (FOODON:00003495).
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add leaves and a little water.
Simmer until tender and lightly creamy from the leaves.

title: Cari Pomme de Terre (Potato Curry)
steps: Peel and chunk potatoes (FOODON:00002796).
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add potatoes and water to cover by one finger.
Simmer until tender; reduce to a thick gravy.

title: Cari Pois (Green Pea Curry)
steps: Sauté onion, bloom curry powder, add peas (pre-soaked/cooked if dried).
Add water and simmer briefly until peas are tender and saucy.

title: Cari Ti Pois Carri (Pigeon Pea Curry)
steps: Cook pigeon peas (FOODON:03301300) until tender.
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; fold in peas with a little cooking liquid.
Simmer 8–10 min to thicken.

title: Cari Ourite (Octopus Curry)
steps: Simmer octopus until tender; slice.
Bloom curry powder; deglaze with a splash of vinegar and water.
Fold in octopus and simmer a few minutes until coated.

title: Cari Crabe (Crab Curry)
steps: Clean and crack crabs.
Bloom curry powder; add vinegar and water to make gravy.
Add crab pieces; cover and simmer until shells go bright and flesh cooks through.

title: Cari Camaron (Freshwater Prawn Curry)
steps: Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add a little water for sauce.
Add prawns (FOODON:03307015) and simmer briefly until just cooked.

title: Cari Cabri (Goat Curry)
steps: Sear goat pieces; remove.
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder.
Return meat, add water, and simmer gently until tender (60–90 min), reducing to a rich gravy.

title: Cari Lapin (Rabbit Curry)
steps: Brown rabbit pieces; set aside.
Bloom curry powder with onion; return meat, add water, and simmer gently until tender (40–50 min).

title: Cari Canard (Duck Curry)
steps: Render duck pieces to release some fat; set aside.
Use the fat to sauté onion; bloom curry powder.
Return duck, add water, and braise until tender and glossy.

title: Cari Dinde (Turkey Curry)
steps: Brown turkey pieces; build a curry base with onion and curry powder.
Add water and simmer until the meat is tender and the gravy thick.

title: Boulettes Soup (Mauritian Dim Sum Soup)
steps: Make a light broth with water, sliced onion, and soy sauce (FOODON:03301115).
Form prawn balls or drop cleaned prawns (FOODON:03307015) into the simmering broth and cook just until done.
Serve hot.

title: Haleem (Mauritian Lentil Stew)
steps: Combine split peas, pigeon peas, and rice; rinse well.
Simmer with plenty of water, stirring occasionally, until grains break down.
Season and mash to a comforting, porridge-like consistency.

title: Kalia (Mauritian Beef Curry)
steps: Sear beef; set aside.
Sauté onions, bloom curry powder, then add a pinch of ginger powder (FOODON:03301844).
Return beef with water; simmer until tender with a medium-thick gravy.

title: Cari Masala Poisson (Fish Masala Curry)
steps: Make a masala base with curry powder and tomatoes.
Slide in fish pieces; spoon sauce over and simmer gently until flaky.

title: Cari Kalia Poulet (Chicken Kalia)
steps: Sauté onions until lightly golden; bloom curry powder generously.
Add chicken and cook covered with a splash of water until tender and saucy.

title: Cari Ourite Lait Coco (Octopus in Coconut Milk Curry)
steps: Cook octopus until tender; slice.
Bloom curry powder; add coconut milk (FOODON:03303084) to form a creamy curry.
Fold in octopus and simmer 2–3 min—do not boil hard.

title: Cari Poisson Lait Coco (Fish in Coconut Milk Curry)
steps: Bloom curry powder; stir in coconut milk to a gentle simmer.
Add fish and poach until just cooked and silky.

title: Cari Camaron Lait Coco (Prawn in Coconut Milk Curry)
steps: Bloom curry powder lightly; add coconut milk.
Slip in prawns and simmer 2–3 min until just pink and tender.

title: Cari Poisson Salé (Salted Fish Curry)
steps: Desalt salted fish (FOODON:03301166) by soaking/changing water; flake.
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add rehydrated fish with a splash of water.
Simmer briefly to marry flavors.

title: Cari Giraumon (Pumpkin Curry)
steps: Cube pumpkin (FOODON:00002180).
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add pumpkin with a little water.
Cover and cook until soft and lightly sweet; reduce to desired thickness.

title: Cari Légumes Mélangés (Mixed Vegetable Curry)
steps: Dice chayote and potatoes; wash spinach.
Sauté onion (if using) and bloom curry powder.
Add firm veg first (potato, chayote), then leafy greens; simmer to a cohesive curry.

title: Cari Ti Pois Brinzel (Pigeon Pea with Eggplant Curry)
steps: Cook pigeon peas until tender.
Sauté cubed eggplant; bloom curry powder in the pan.
Combine with peas and simmer to thicken.

title: Cari Bred Mouroum (Moringa Leaves Curry)
steps: Strip moringa leaves; rinse well.
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add leaves with a splash of water.
Cover and cook until tender and green.

title: Cari Bred Martin (Spinach Curry)
steps: Roughly chop spinach.
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add spinach and cook down to a soft curry.

title: Cari Calou (Watercress Curry)
steps: Wash watercress thoroughly.
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add watercress and cook briefly until tender but vibrant.

title: Cari Tofu (Tofu Curry)
steps: Cube tofu; optionally pan-sear until golden.
Sauté onion; bloom curry powder; add tofu with a little water and simmer 5 min.

title: Cari Paneer (Indian Cheese Curry)
steps: Cube paneer and lightly sear (optional).
Build a curry base with onion and curry powder; add paneer and simmer gently to absorb flavors.

title: Roti Cari Gros Pois (Flatbread with Broad Bean Curry)
steps: Cook broad/pigeon peas until tender.
Make a quick curry with curry powder and a little water; fold in peas.
Warm rotis (FOODON:03302459) and serve filled with the curry.

title: Farata with Cari Legumes
steps: Prepare a simple chayote curry (see Cari Chouchou method).
Warm faratas (FOODON:03302460) and serve with the vegetable curry.

title: Roti with Cari Poulet
steps: Cook a small batch of chicken curry (see Chicken Curry method).
Warm rotis and roll with the chicken curry inside.

title: Bol Renversé (Upside Down Bowl)
steps: Cook noodles and set aside.
Stir-fry onion and chicken strips; splash with a little vinegar and water to make a light gravy.
Pack a small bowl with the saucy stir-fry, top with noodles, press, and invert onto a plate to serve.

title: Mine Frit Poulet (Chicken Fried Noodles)
steps: Boil noodles until al dente; drain.
Stir-fry onion and chicken until cooked.
Add noodles; season with soy sauce and toss over high heat until glossy.

title: Mine Frit Boeuf (Beef Fried Noodles)
steps: Boil noodles; drain.
Stir-fry onion and beef strips until just cooked.
Add noodles and soy; toss hot and fast.

title: Mine Frit Légumes (Vegetarian Fried Noodles)
steps: Boil noodles; drain.
Stir-fry onion and sliced chayote until just tender.
Add noodles and soy; toss to coat.

title: Bouillon Légumes (Vegetable Soup)
steps: Bring water to a simmer; add onion, diced chayote, and spinach.
Season lightly and cook until vegetables are tender but bright.

title: Bouillon Poisson (Fish Soup)
steps: Simmer a light broth with water, onion, and soy sauce for seasoning.
Add chunks of fish and poach gently until just cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Curry
steps: Sear chicken pieces (FOODON:02020149) to light gold; set aside.
Soften onion; bloom curry powder; add tomatoes to make a base.
Return chicken, add water, and simmer until tender and saucy (25–35 min).

title: Beef Curry
steps: Sear beef pieces (FOODON:00001282) to brown; set aside.
Soften onion; bloom curry powder; add tomatoes to make a base.
Return beef, add water, and simmer until tender and saucy (60–90 min).
